modmenu.descriptionTranslation.qol_unifi: An all-in-one, modular, client-side quality-of-life mod.
qol_unified.settings.restart_required_su: Takes effect after restarting the game
qol_unified.tooltip.unknown: Could not be fully disabled and may still be active. Retry, or restart the game to be sure.
qol_unified.message.read_only: Settings cannot be saved: the configuration file is from a newer version or could not be safely read.
qol_unified.message.invalid: Fix the highlighted values before saving.
qol_unified.message.save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Your changes were kept here; see the log.
qol_unified.message.apply_failed: Settings were saved, but some features could not be changed: %s. See the log.
qol_unified.message.restart: Settings saved. Some changes take effect after restarting the game.
qol_unified.message.retry_failed: The feature still could not be disabled. Restart the game to be sure.
qol_unified.error.not_a_number: Enter a whole number between %s and %s.
qol_unified.feature.food_hud.name: Food HUD
qol_unified.feature.food_hud.description: Shows your saturation and what held food would restore. Previews are estimates.
qol_unified.feature.food_hud.conflict.ap: AppleSkin shows the same food information on the HUD and in tooltips.
qol_unified.food_hud.debug: Food: %s, saturation: %s (last value sent by the server)
qol_unified.feature.chat_heads.name: Chat Heads
qol_unified.feature.chat_heads.descripti: Shows the sender's head next to player chat messages. Only messages that carry the sender's profile get a head.
Chat Heads adds heads to the same chat messages.
qol_unified.feature.keyboard_map.name: Keyboard Map
qol_unified.feature.keyboard_map.descrip: A visual keyboard of your key bindings: find free keys and keys used by more than one action, search, and change bindings with Minecraft's own controls.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.title: Keyboard Map
qol_unified.keyboard_map.layout: Keyboard layout (the physical keys; labels come from your system)
qol_unified.keyboard_map.not_on_layout: This key is not on the selected keyboard layout
qol_unified.keyboard_map.overlap_explana: %s actions use this input; Minecraft runs all of them when it is pressed.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.capturing: Press a key or mouse button for "%s". Escape cancels.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.legend: Gray: free · green: one action · red with a number: shared. Click a key, the mouse or an action.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.empty_input: No action uses this input. Pick an unbound action to assign it here.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.capturing_short: Press a key or mouse button... (Esc cancels)
qol_unified.keyboard_map.confirm_hint: The new input is already used. Use it anyway, or cancel.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.card_hint: Change, Clear or Reset an action. Esc or ✕ returns to all actions.
qol_unified.keyboard_map.wheel_note: Scrolling the wheel is not a key binding in Minecraft and cannot be remapped; only the wheel click can.
qol_unified.feature.target_info.name: Target Info
qol_unified.feature.target_info.descript: Shows what you are looking at: name, source mod, suitable tools, mining progress, health and a few block states. Uses only information the game already has.
qol_unified.feature.target_info.conflict: Jade shows its own overlay for the same target.
WTHIT shows its own overlay for the same target.
qol_unified.feature.sound_control.name: Sound Control
qol_unified.feature.sound_control.descri: Lower or mute individual sounds. Sounds that share an event, like TNT and Creeper explosions, change together.
qol_unified.feature.sound_control.confli: Extreme Sound Muffler also changes the volume of individual sounds.
Sound Controller also changes the volume of individual sounds.
Decibel also changes the volume of individual sounds.
qol_unified.sound_control.title: Sound Control
qol_unified.sound_control.mute.tooltip: Silence this sound. Its volume setting is kept.
qol_unified.sound_control.unmute.tooltip: Play this sound again at its volume setting.
qol_unified.sound_control.reset_all.mess: All %s changed sounds return to normal volume when you press Done.
qol_unified.sound_control.count_limited: Showing %s of %s sounds. Refine the search.
qol_unified.sound_control.all_hint: Type at least 2 letters or choose a filter to search %s sounds.
qol_unified.sound_control.empty.recent: No sounds heard yet. Play for a moment and come back, or search all sounds.
qol_unified.sound_control.empty.rules: No sounds changed. Use the slider or Mute on any sound.
qol_unified.sound_control.no_audio: Minecraft has no audio device right now, so no sounds are being heard.
qol_unified.sound_control.note: Sounds that share an event change together: TNT and Creeper explosions are one event.
qol_unified.sound_control.limit: Limit reached: at most %s sounds can be changed.
qol_unified.feature.shulker_preview.name: Shulker Preview
qol_unified.feature.shulker_preview.desc: Shows what is inside shulker boxes: the main item and a fill bar on the slot, a summary on hover and the full 9×3 grid while holding Shift. Uses only what the game already sends.
qol_unified.feature.shulker_preview.conf: Shulker Box Tooltip shows its own preview in the same tooltip.
Simple Shulker Preview draws its own icon on the same slots.
qol_unified.feature.shulker_preview.sett: Main item and fill bar on the slot
qol_unified.settings.applies_when_on: This feature is OFF. Changes apply when it is ON.
qol_unified.settings.action_needs_active: Turn the feature ON and press Done first.
qol_unified.settings.comparison.in_world: Example available while in a world.
qol_unified.message.save_failed_retry: The change could not be saved and was not applied. Retry, or undo it.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.name: Zoom
qol_unified.feature.zoom.description: Hold the Zoom key to zoom the camera smoothly; scroll while zoomed to zoom further. Your FOV and sensitivity options are never changed.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.conflict.zoomif: Zoomify also zooms the camera; both would apply.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.conflict.ok_zoo: Ok Zoomer also zooms the camera; both would apply.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.conflict.logica: Logical Zoom also zooms the camera; both would apply.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.error.initial_o: must be between the minimum (%s×) and the maximum (%s×). Change those first.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.error.min_above: cannot be above the initial magnification (%s×). Raise the initial magnification first.
qol_unified.feature.zoom.error.max_below: cannot be below the initial magnification (%s×). Lower the initial magnification first.
qol_unified.feature.mouse_tweaks.name: Inventory Mouse Tweaks
qol_unified.feature.mouse_tweaks.descrip: Faster inventory handling with the mouse: right-drag places one item per slot, left-drag gathers matching items, Shift + drag moves stacks, and the wheel moves items one at a time.
qol_unified.feature.mouse_tweaks.note: Not active in the creative inventory.
qol_unified.feature.mouse_tweaks.conflic: Mouse Tweaks adds the same inventory gestures.
Mouse Wheelie also moves items with the wheel and drags.
Item Scroller also moves items with the wheel and drags.
qol_unified.feature.inventory_search.des: Adds a small search field to the inventory, chests, barrels, Ender Chests, Shulker Boxes and hoppers. Matching items are framed and the others dimmed; nothing is moved. Searches item names, ids and enchantments. Ctrl+F focuses it.
qol_unified.feature.inventory_search.not: Not shown in the creative inventory, which has its own search.
